column6: detail

ADD-01/3.1 adds an obligation (ADD-01:3.1); the summary does not mention it: 'The attendance record is held by the Authority. A Bidder that considers its attendance to have been incorrectly recorded shall notify the Authority through the Portal within five (5) Working Days of this Addendum.'
ADD-01/AppA/para1 replaces VOL-IV:F4-A; the summary does not mention it: 'Form 4-A is reissued below to add the acknowledgement of Addenda at paragraph 1. Bidders shall use this version.'
ADD-02:7.2 states 'Failure to submit Form 4-G shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'adds Form 4-G'

'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6', but ADD-02/9.1 reinstates it in an amended form: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty-five per cent (35%) for the construction phase. Failure …' (as issued: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty per cent (30%) f…')
ADD-02:9.1 states 'Failure to submit the certificate shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6'

ADD-02/T1-1-rev/note(2) amends VOL-I:11.2; the summary does not mention it: '(2) The combined score weighting stated in Volume I Clause 11.2 is amended to sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial.'
ADD-02/5.2 adds an obligation (VOL-II:S3); the summary does not mention it: 'Bidders shall reflect the amended limit in the process design submitted under Volume II Section 3.'
ADD-02/9.2 ends the effect of ADD-01:4.2; the summary does not mention it: 'Section 4.2 of Addendum No. 1 ceases to have effect.'

'incorporates the Network Operator's Table 1-3 describing the two tie-in points referred to in Volume II Clause 1.3': C28 does not know the verb 'incorporates', so what it claims is compared by its targets only; a person reads it against the provisions

'requires a Bidder that elects to interrupt flows at a tie-in point to obtain the Authority's acceptance of its shutdown programme, applications for which shall be made within eight (8) Working Days of the date of this Addendum': no provision of ADD-03 does this
'introduces a flow range for the reliability run in Volume II Clause 7.2', but ADD-03/3.1 amends VOL-II:7.2

'adds to Volume V Clause 31.1 a new Unavailability Event for loss of treated effluent volume, with no cure period and with no deduction during the Ramp-Up Period': no provision of ADD-03 matches 'with no cure period and with no deduction during the Ramp-Up Period'
'adds to Volume V Clause 31.1 a new Unavailability Event for loss of treated effluent volume, with no cure period and with no deduction during the Ramp-Up Period', but ADD-03/5.1 amends VOL-V:31.1

ADD-03/4.1(b) deletes VOL-II:8.2; the summary does not mention it: 'Volume II Clauses 8.1 to 8.3 are deleted and replaced by the following: ‘8.1 The Project Company shall hold a spare parts inventory sufficient for eighteen (18) months of normal operation for all items with a lead time exceeding twelve (12…'

ADD-03/4.1(c) amends VOL-II:8.3; the summary does not mention it: 'Volume II Clauses 8.1 to 8.3 are deleted and replaced by the following: ‘8.1 The Project Company shall hold a spare parts inventory sufficient for eighteen (18) months of normal operation for all items with a lead time exceeding twelve (12…'

ADD-03/5.2 amends VOL-V:31.3; the summary does not mention it: 'In Volume V Clause 31.3, ‘No cure period applies to an event under Clause 31.1(b).’ is deleted and ‘No cure period applies to an event under Clause 31.1(b) or Clause 31.1(d).’ is substituted.'
